component.name: Tabless
component.summary: A developer's workday in one window

description.p: Tabless is a desktop app for developers whose work lives in a shared tracker. It brings the tasks assigned to you, today's meetings and your notes into one window, so the morning starts in one place instead of a tracker tab, a calendar tab and a notes app.

ul.li: Works with 13 trackers: GitHub, GitLab, Jira, Trello, Gitea, Forgejo, Redmine, Todoist, Asana, ClickUp, Sentry, Bitbucket, and Mattermost for @mentions — one of them or several.
Today shows the day's meetings (from your calendar links) and planned tasks in order, with what's in progress and what's due.
Capture from any app: press Ctrl+Shift+Space and type "review PR tomorrow 11:00 p1 #api". Date, time, priority and label are read from the words.
Check out a branch named after a task and that task moves to the top. PR state comes from your own gh or glab.
Markdown notes next to the tasks they mention. Bring an Obsidian vault in, with a preview first.
Keyboard throughout: Vim-style keys that work in any layout, a command line on Ctrl+K, every key rebindable.
A command line tool too: "tabless today", "tabless add", "tabless now" for your shell prompt.

description.p: What it won't do without asking:

ul.li: Write to your tracker. It's read-only until you turn status updates on for that tracker; titles, descriptions and comments are never written.
Send your data anywhere. Everything is one JSON file on your disk. No account, no analytics.
Lose your work. Daily backups and a time machine of snapshots.

description.p: Good to know: it's a personal desk, not a team board, and there's no mobile app. Moving work between computers is export and import for now.
Free and open source (MIT). Windows, macOS and Linux.

screenshot.caption: Today: the day's meetings and planned tasks by the hour
A task open as a document

description.p: Waiting for me: merge requests where someone waits for you, in the sidebar. CI read the same everywhere, with the failed jobs and the end of the log. The calendar as its own section, small screens, upcoming due dates, pictures at full size, Settings one section per screen, and a calmer network.
One-time hints that show a feature where you meet it, rich notes, a tracker card that reads on a small screen, and the Tabless Blue theme.
